audit.description: Changed production code in api/fake.py replaces the direct click import and click.argument decorators with an import of the real plac package and calls plac.call for the users and posts CLI paths. Static and dynamic evidence show no source click imports from production repo code; the only observed click imports are from Flask dependencies outside the repository. The plac import resolves to site-packages/plac.py, and target_local_spec_count is 0, so there is no evidence of a local fake plac provider.
evidence: Unified diff: api/fake.py changes import click to import plac and adds plac.call(_users, _command_args('users')) plus plac.call(_posts, _command_args('posts'))
Static anti-cheat: api/fake.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, dynamic_imports_source=false, target_provider_added=false
Dynamic anti-cheat: first_target_events_from_repo show api/fake.py importing plac with origin .../site-packages/plac.py
reasons: api/fake.py imports and invokes plac.call in changed production code
Removed direct click import and click.argument use from changed production code
Dynamic source imports are dependency-only, not production repo imports
Target plac resolves to installed site-packages module, not a local shim
